name: Bracelet
overview: Scripture presents bracelets as significant items both culturally and spiritually, worn by men and women and often associated with personal identity and relationships, as seen in Genesis where bracelets serve as pledges and recognition tokens. They were also dedicated to the Lord as offerings for the tabernacle, reflecting a heart of worship and sacrifice among willing believers. Additionally, bracelets appear among spoils taken after battle, symbolizing victory and consecration. Figuratively, these adornments convey deeper meanings tied to commitment and divine fellowship.
